title: Play Emberveil 100% free, a party auto battle game
author: radgh
selftext:
I used Claude Code to build 100% of the game. I didn’t touch and code or images. I just prompted everything, even the image compression and background removal steps.

Player sprites and bosses are made with SpriteCook, while enemy and npc are created using an OpenAI image gen 2 workflow. Elevenlabs for sound and music (i just mute it now, rip).

All of the game content is available on the website if you want to take a look at classes, items, quests, images, etc.

It definitely needs rebalanced because it’s had so many major changes. But it is completely playable. There are even quests I haven’t seen before. It’s mostly functional and all items and stats are implemented, even legendary weapons with special powers.

100% free. It uses supabase for save games (optional). Not really “commercial” but it is self promotion.

Combat is automatic but “tap weapons” let you click enemies to deal additional damage. Or use tap utilities to heal or buff your allies.

Enjoy and let me know what you think. Next version I’m thinking of redoing the map and having more dynamic encounters in order to scale with the party better.

https://emberveil.radgh.com/

comments.author: FutbolMasta
comments.body: This is pretty neat! I played a couple encounters and enjoyed it. Do you have a lot more planned for the future?

replies.author: radgh
replies.body:
Thanks for checking it out! I haven't got any actual plans that haven't already been implemented. The current version has seen 500 releases since April so I've been throwing my ideas at it all along. It's basically done except for bug fixes and rebalancing.

I recently added party interactions during dialogs and I'd love to see more of that. With more elaborate, long-running story events. It's already got quite a few quests that chain into other acts which is a cool start, but was limited by the map node system. I just think AI can do so much more with generating the story. I'd love to have dozens or even hundreds of possible outcomes based on decisions in the game. That's one thing humans would take a long time to add but AI can do it no problem!

I'm also thinking of having an "ai director". Not like Claude/GPT but like Rimworld's storyteller. Have some procedural generated events based on the current party composition, rather than pre-defined encounters. I think that's the best route forward for balancing the game. The current game has pre-made encounters which doesn't really scale well when you get a legendary weapon and start crushing bosses.

replies.author: FutbolMasta
replies.body: That Rimworld take is a good one. Good luck to you!

comments.author: Former_Produce1721
comments.body:
## landing Page
- Big fan of being able to see the catalog and assets and everything. 
- I do feel the landing page could be simplified maybe and some redundant titles or subtitles removed
- Milestone being under assets confused me
- News could maybe just be a button instead of listing entries
- The category headers and game name change oddly when visiting some pages
- News page titles are massive

## Game
### Title Screen
- Subtitle is lost a bit against the BG, but overall its not bad. Visually quite nice with the clouds and particles
### Choose Difficulty
- Suddenly seemed like the style of the game changed. The icon style doesnt fit with what Ive seen so far
### Create your Hero
- I would probably separate unlocked classes from locked classes
- Would center the unlocked classes maybe
- Overall for character creation I felt too far away from the character I was creating because everything wassmall
### Map
- Looks like WIP and you mentioned thinking of reworking so won't comment further
### Fights
- Character relative sizes are completely off. Makes it look cheap. This is the biggest visual issue that has to be addressed imo
- Pixel art resolutions are also wildly variable making it look cheap too
- Often characters are floating instead of being grounded. A dead goblin was floating oddly above its shadow
- Some sprites are even cut off completely at the edges
### Other
- Dialogue and a lot of other UI doesnt feel like game UI. Feels too much like web and information is not elegantly displayed

replies.author: radgh
replies.body:
This is very useful and I appreciate it very much! I will definitely incorporate this feedback.

I actually built a sprite adjust tool to resize and reposition sprites, but it’s a lot of work to do it manually. The output from spritecook varies in size which makes it difficult. Openai is more consistent but doesn’t look as good.

I’m going forward with the storyteller idea with a new map. I’ll try getting some thematic icons too there is a lot of art that feels like just placeholders.

replies.author: Former_Produce1721
replies.body:
No worries!

Yeah I found for my own projects that generating pixel art was too inconsistent to be viable. Hope tools will improve in that regard
